basePinPolicy: Resolve the exact authorized base at activation; record it in Weavr and the Faictory workspace. The inspected SHA is evidence, not a substitute for that future pin.
acceptance: S1-RULES: Official UZH/template requirements, train/dev dataset and evaluator revisions, license/provenance and unresolved rule questions are recorded with source evidence.
S1-SPLIT: Every loader, CLI and cache path rejects every split except train/dev before filesystem/network I/O; no all-split acquisition or held-out test access occurs.
S1-TOKENS: Canonical source/target tokens and offsets preserve official order and exact vector lengths, including Unicode, punctuation and repeated tokens; mismatch fails without padding/truncation.

S1-MANIFEST: A fixed 5–10-pair dev manifest records IDs, language counts, source revision and content hashes; shortfall becomes an unresolved Need, not invented data; gold is absent from inference input.

S1-EVAL: A synthetic parity fixture agrees with the pinned official evaluator, including -1 masking, ties, undefined constant correlations and per-language/macro aggregation; no unofficial numeric score substitutes for parity.
S1-SCALE: Documented similarity/difference conversion and internal severity agree with the pinned evaluator and pass explicit mapping/range tests.

S1-RUNTIME: One opt-in real Apertus request records returned model identity, request settings, bounded attempts, latency and safe evidence; missing access/model/context/budget stays BLOCKED and never counts as a passing live check.

S1-REVIEW: Independent Codex review of the exact candidate commit/diff digest reruns required checks, reports each criterion and unresolved Needs, and makes a recommendation only; human approval and integration remain separate.

requiredCheckCommands.requirement: all regression and S1 contract suites pass; record names/counts so zero discovered tests cannot count
positive test count and observed split/token/manifest/evaluator/severity/provider contract coverage
test split refused; dedicated I/O spies additionally prove no loader/cache/network I/O

liveCheck.requestLimit: one logical request, no retry by default; any retries/cost ceiling must come from approved configuration
liveCheck.evidence: actual returned model identity and provenance; no credential/header serialization; unavailable measurements remain unavailable

closure.pass: Every required criterion verified, including real smoke; independent review recommends PASS; no unresolved blocking Need. PASS remains advisory.
closure.blocked: Missing runtime, official parity, source/license/rule evidence or current control-plane state remains BLOCKED. Partial plumbing evidence can still be submitted.
closure.revision: New bounded attempt; new capture/verification/review on any changed digest; no automatic replay or broadened scope.
closure.nextStage: S2 requires separate human decision, explicit integration and exact resulting commit pin, fresh canonical Weavr read and explicit next-Mission authorization.
